feedTitle: Weather forecast for the Isle of Man

items.title: Weather forecast updated as of 22 October 2026 8:15am
items.description:
##Weather##

Issued on Thursday, 22 October 2026 at 8:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Detailed forecast##

Fine today, with sunny spells and mainly light winds. Maximum temperature 12°C. Then tonight rain will arrive, this becoming persistent and quite heavy as winds become stronger.

Heavy rain will continue at first tomorrow, bringing a risk of localised flooding, before gradually clearing to sunny intervals in the afternoon. Strong northwest winds, touching gale force in exposed spots for a time, the maximum temperature 12°C.


##Outlook##

An very unsettled weekend, with heavy rain again on Saturday, this clearing to sunny intervals and isolated showers for Sunday.

However, winds will be the main issue, with gales at times Saturday daytime, then severe gales overnight into Sunday. Travel disruption will occur and possibly some damage, before winds gradually ease later on Sunday.
